note: Cross-language destination rule host vectors (ferentin-platform#3102, #3103). Shared byte-identically with ferentin-endpoint (crates/policy-engine/tests/fixtures/cross_language/). Expectations are hand-authored from the agent's grammar, not recorded from either implementation. `validity`: whether a value is accepted in a destination rule's destination_hosts (valid_rule_host plus validate_list's non-empty and 512-byte bounds). One refused host refuses the whole endpoint policy on the device, so admin-api must refuse at least every value refused here. `matching`: whether a rule host matches a flow's host (host_matches). The console's coverage verdict must answer as the device does.
